target.title: security(audit): flag reachable plugin command chat surfaces
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`openclaw security audit` could miss extension plugin commands that bypass the LLM on native chat command surfaces, especially when:

1. enabled extensions register `commandAliases`, and
2. a channel has native commands enabled, and/or
3. `plugins.allow` is unset while native command/skill surfaces are configured.

**Concrete example:** Discord with native commands enabled and `plugins.allow: ["some-plugin"]` where the plugin registers commands — operators previously got tool-policy warnings but not a distinct command-surface finding. Unallowlisted extensions on native surfaces were also not clearly elevated when plugin commands can run before the LLM.

Control-plane (`gateway`/`cron`) open-ingress auditing is intentionally **out of scope** here and left to #100965 to avoid duplicate audit-contract IDs.

## Why This Change Was Made

Extend the plugin-trust audit collector so configured native command surfaces and commandful extension plugins emit dedicated findings, and make command detection upgrade-safe when persisted plugin registries omit optional `contributions` metadata (fall back to manifest `commandAliases`).

## User Impact

**Before:** Operators could miss LLM-bypass plugin command reachability on chat command surfaces; stale registries without `contributions` could silently hide that risk.

**After:** Audit emits `plugins.commands_reachable_chat_surface` (warn) when commandful extensions meet native command surfaces, and may raise `plugins.extensions_no_allowlist` to critical when native command/skill surfaces are configured without `plugins.allow`.

## Evidence

- `src/security/audit-plugins-trust.ts` — command-surface collection + manifest fallback for missing `contributions`
- `src/security/audit-plugins-trust.test.ts` — reachability cases + stale-registry regression
- `docs/gateway/security/audit-checks.md` — documents the new/changed check IDs
- Diff vs `main`: 3 files only (no control-plane / `audit-extra.sync.ts` overlap with #100965)

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Plugin command chat-surface exposure was under-audited; missing persisted `contributions` could false-negative the new check.
- **Real environment tested:** macOS (Darwin), Node.js v22.22.0, local checkout after rebase onto latest `upstream/main`.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
  1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/security/audit-plugins-trust.test.ts --reporter=verbose`
- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/security/audit-plugins-trust.test.ts --reporter=verbose

 ✓ security audit install metadata findings > evaluates install metadata findings 345ms
 ✓ security audit install metadata findings > evaluates phantom allowlist findings 13ms
 ✓ security audit install metadata findings > ignores install backup and debris dirs when auditing installed plugin roots 5ms
 ✓ security audit install metadata findings > does not report bundled provider and utility plugins as phantom allowlist entries 3ms
 ✓ security audit extension tool reachability findings > evaluates extension tool reachability findings 25ms
 ✓ security audit extension tool reachability findings > flags plugin commands when persisted registry omits contributions metadata 3ms

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  6 passed (6)
```

Table-driven / regression coverage includes:

| Case | Finding | Severity |
|------|---------|----------|
| enabled extension + native commands | `plugins.commands_reachable_chat_surface` | warn |
| native commands disabled | no command-surface finding | — |
| no `plugins.allow` + native commands | `plugins.extensions_no_allowlist` | critical |
| persisted registry omits `contributions` | `plugins.commands_reachable_chat_surface` via manifest fallback | warn |

- **Observed result after fix:** Production `collectPluginsTrustFindings` emits the command-surface warning for commandful plugins on native surfaces, and still does so when index records lack `contributions` by reading manifest `commandAliases`.
- **What was not tested:** Full interactive `pnpm openclaw security audit --deep` against a multi-channel production config file; Vitest drives the production collector. Control-plane open-ingress checks are owned by #100965.

## AI-assisted disclosure

- [x] AI-assisted (Cursor agent)
- [x] Human-directed scope: drop control-plane overlap with #100965; keep plugin command surface + upgrade-safe metadata fix
